events.title: Write the Cleanup Headline
must_haves: One square finished social graphic is delivered.
A short, readable English headline encourages beach cleanup or keeping beaches clean.
The headline is embedded in the image, not merely supplied in the chat response.
The illustration visibly depicts a beach and a cleanup activity, such as collecting litter.
No dates or signup details appear.

answer_sheet.Headline language and purpose: English; encourage people to help clean up their local beach.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: Square social graphic; no particular platform.
answer_sheet.Event details or additional copy: No dates or signup details; no event information needs to be invented.

events.text: Even the cheapest option was refused, so I need to stop and explain that to the user.

I couldn't make the graphic. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and there's no download link.

I tried two free-plan image models, both square at 640px:
- **qwen-image-2.1** (from 10 credits per image), because it's best at clear text. The account refused it for insufficient credits.
- **z-image-turbo** (from 5 credits per image), one of the cheapest options. It was refused for the same reason.

Here's the design I planned:
- **Headline:** "LOVE YOUR BEACH"
- **Tagline:** "Pitch in & clean it up!"
- **Scene:** A friendly flat illustration of a sunny beach with turquoise waves, seagulls, a smiling crab and seashells. Cheerful volunteers of different ages pick up litter with grabbers and reusable bags next to a recycling bin.
- No dates or signup details.

**To get it made:** Once your account has at least 5–10 credits, either from your plan's credits renewing or from buying a credit pack, ask me again and I'll generate it.
